head: d8352fe1eba11a07971ea92b1184a24e1d73a10e
title: fix(invite-codes): Who joined reads the redemption ledger; Resend really re-sends (AUDIT-17-125)
body:
**Tier:** T3 (reads which clients redeemed a coach's code; no write path, no attach change).
**Why:** AUDIT-17-125 (invites and bulk invite): the coach's "Who joined" list was a guess and the invite Resend never re-sent.
**T4 trigger scan:** none built. Attach / seat / tenancy logic is untouched. The redeemer read keeps the same IDOR gate (`invite.coach_id === caller`) and narrows the rows to ledger ids that are still this coach's students (`coach_id`, `role: student`, `deleted_at: null`), so it can only show fewer people than before, never another coach's client. The resend keeps the ownership and revoked checks.
**T3 trigger scan:** decides which client records a coach sees for a code (read only). No migration, flag, dependency or lockfile.
**Bounded T1:** 4 files, 133 changed lines (90 + / 43 -): service 75, tests 58.
**Canonical builder:** AUDIT-17-125 (agent 125, Claude Opus 5.5).
**Acceptance evidence:** local targeted jest (heavy.sh) on this head: `test/invite-redeemers-ledger.spec.ts`, `test/invite-codes-redeemers.spec.ts`, `test/invite-bulk-email.spec.ts` 3 suites / 12 tests pass. Full suites and tsc in this PR's CI.

## U fixed (each with its one-sentence user story)
- **U-4 "Who joined" shows the wrong clients.** A coach taps "Who joined" on a code (Codes screen, counts from the InviteRedemption ledger) and the list is built from "students who signed up between the code's creation and now, capped at used_count", so it can show clients who joined with a different code or the coach link, gives their sign-up date as the redemption date, and misses a client who signed up first on coachless Home (FEATURE_COACHLESS_HOME on) and entered the code later. `listRedeemersForCoach` now reads `InviteRedemption` rows for this `invite_code_id` (the same ledger the Codes counts use), adds `accepted_by_user_id` for a first redemption made before the ledger existed, and returns only those users who are still this coach's students, with `redeemed_at` from the ledger. Response shape unchanged.
- **U-1 (backend half) Resend never re-sends.** A coach taps Resend on a pending emailed invite and nothing is sent, because the first send spent the email key `invite:<id>` and `EmailService.send` answers `skipped` for any reuse. `sendInviteEmailForCode` now uses `invite:<id>:resend:<minute>`: a double tap still sends once, a later Resend really sends. The bulk send keeps `invite:<id>`. The mobile half (m#423) shows the real outcome on both old and new backends.

## Tests (fail on main where behaviour changes)
- New `test/invite-redeemers-ledger.spec.ts`: a late (coachless-first) redeemer and a pre-ledger first redeemer are listed with their redemption times, only ledger ids are queried, only current students of this coach. On main the ledger is never read and the result comes from the signup-time window.
- `test/invite-codes-redeemers.spec.ts`: fixture gains the ledger rows; same assertions.
- `test/invite-bulk-email.spec.ts`: the resend key is `invite:<id>:resend:<n>` (main: `invite:<id>`).

## Overlap
b#782 (HUNT-03-124) edits the same file (`invite-codes.service.ts`) in different hunks (code-shape helpers near line 103, previewCode, attachUserToCoachByCode, resolveAttachTarget). This PR touches only `listRedeemersForCoach`, `sendInviteEmailForCode` and `_sendInviteEmail` plus one constant; no textual overlap.
Companion mobile PR: growth-project-mobile#423.
